qa_pairs.question: What is the general backup policy for home and project spaces on the clusters, and how can a user recover files?
qa_pairs.answer: Home and project spaces undergo nightly backups, which are retained for 30 days. Deleted files are retained for an additional 60 days. To recover a previous version of a file or directory, users should contact technical support, providing the full path to the file(s) and the desired version by date.

qa_pairs.question: What are the storage characteristics, including quotas and backup status, for the $HOME, $SCRATCH, and $PROJECT filesystems on the Vulcan cluster for various user roles?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Vulcan cluster, the $HOME directory has a 50 GB quota per user and is backed up. The $SCRATCH space offers a consistent 5 TB per user across all AI-related faculty and affiliate roles, is not backed up, and files are purged after 2 months. The $PROJECT quotas vary by role: CIFAR AI Chairs receive 12.5 TB, AI Institute Faculty Affiliates get 10 TB, Faculty members within an AI program get 7.5 TB, and Faculty members applying AI to other domains get 5 TB. The $PROJECT space on Vulcan is backed up.

qa_pairs.question: Is the $PROJECT space on the TamIA cluster backed up, and what are its typical quotas for different user types?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the $PROJECT space on the TamIA cluster is not backed up. Its quotas vary by user type: CIFAR AI Chairs receive 5 TB, AI Institute Faculty Affiliates receive 2 TB, and both Faculty members within an AI program and those applying AI to other domains receive 500 GB.
